fields.label: Special industry rules
fields.value: Special rules apply to motor carriers, which apportion traveling employee compensation based on vehicle mileage, and financial institutions, which apportion net equity capital using a single gross receipts factor. Additionally, electric light and local exchange telephone companies use an equally weighted three-factor formula.

fields.label: Forms
fields.value: Individuals compute apportionment using Schedule IT BUS, while pass-through entities use Form IT 4708 Schedule IV or Form IT 4738. Withholding tax apportionment is reported on Form IT 1140 Schedule C.

fields.label: Individual income tax
fields.value: For 2025, nonbusiness income is taxed at 0% up to $26,050, 2.75% from $26,050 to $100,000, and 3.125% over $100,000. Taxable business income is taxed at a flat rate of 3.0% after the Business Income Deduction.

fields.label: Pass-through entity tax (PTET)
fields.value: Ohio has an elective pass-through entity tax levied at a rate of 3%. Entities elect annually by filing Form IT 4738 or submitting Form EPTE-ELEC on or before the filing deadline including extensions, which is irrevocable once made.

fields.label: Composite returns
fields.value: A pass-through entity may file an annual composite return using Form IT 4708 on behalf of direct and indirect investors at a tax rate of 3.125%. Nonresident investors whose only Ohio-sourced income is included on Form IT 4708 are exempt from filing an individual return.

fields.label: Withholding and estimated payments
fields.value: For tax year 2026, estimated tax due dates for IT 1140, IT 4738, and IT 4708 align to April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15. Form IT 1140 withholding applies at a 3% rate when an entity's adjusted qualifying amount exceeds $1,000.

fields.label: Key forms
fields.value: Key individual tax forms include IT 1040 and SD 100, while Ohio levies no general corporate net income tax. Core pass-through entity forms include Form IT 1140 for withholding, Form IT 4708 for composite filers, Form IT 4738 for elective PTET, and Ohio IT K-1.
